# ssdt-review — review a schema pull request

Adopt the **reviewer** role for the ssdt-agent workflow: read
`ssdt-agent/agents/reviewer.md` (from the repository root) and follow it exactly, then
proceed with the request that accompanies this prompt.

Point this at a schema pull request. The reviewer role reproduces the author's proof on
an isolated database, scopes the dependencies, attacks the claim, and renders one of four
dispositions — approved, approved with a named risk, returned, or escalated.

These prompt files exist for editors without custom agents (Visual Studio 2022). In
Visual Studio 2026, select the `@reviewer` agent from the picker instead.
